name: @kubohiroya/tm-kamishibai
description: TM Kamishibai — an AI-powered interactive storytelling system built on the TurboWarp ecosystem, using Teachable Machine recognition as story input

scripts.dsl4:assets:convert: pnpm run build:lib && node bin/tm-kamishibai.mjs convert-dsl4-assets
scripts.e2e:preview: pnpm run build:lib && vitest run test/dsl4-browser-preview-source-adapter.test.mjs test/dsl4-preview-source-protocol-port.test.mjs test/dsl4-web-preview-shell.test.mjs test/dsl4-browser-preview-asset-adapter.test.mjs test/dsl4-browser-asset-reload-pipeline.test.mjs test/dsl4-preview-reload-overlay.test.mjs
scripts.e2e:chromium: pnpm run build:lib && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.e2e:chromium:preview: pnpm run build:lib && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts test/e2e/dsl4-web-preview-chromium.test.mjs
scripts.e2e:chromium:distribution: pnpm run build:lib && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts test/e2e/dsl4-asset-distribution-offline-chromium.test.mjs
scripts.test:quick: pnpm run build:lib && node scripts/test/run-suite.mjs quick
scripts.test:full: pnpm run build:lib && node scripts/test/run-suite.mjs full
scripts.verify:quick: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:quick
scripts.verify:pr: pnpm sb3:check && pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:quick
scripts.verify:full: pnpm sb3:check && pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:full && pnpm e2e && pnpm build && pnpm pack:smoke
scripts.release:dsl4:update: pnpm run build:lib && node scripts/sb3/dsl4-release-workflow.mjs update
scripts.release:dsl4:check: pnpm run build:lib && node scripts/sb3/dsl4-release-workflow.mjs check
scripts.release:dsl4:verify-published-snapshot: pnpm run build:lib && node scripts/sb3/dsl4-release-workflow.mjs verify-published-snapshot
scripts.release:dsl4:freeze: pnpm run build:lib && node scripts/sb3/dsl4-release-workflow.mjs freeze
scripts.release:dsl4:record-publication: pnpm run build:lib && node scripts/sb3/dsl4-release-workflow.mjs record-publication
scripts.prepack: pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:lib && vitest run test/builder.test.mjs test/dsl32-converter.test.mjs && pnpm pack:smoke

author: Hiroya Kubo
